svg.text: Step 1. Download/load ontology; chunk text; embed chunks; index embeddings in FAISS.
Step 2. For each property in the process schema:
if it matches a known ontology term, assign ontology metadata directly.
else query FAISS, retrieve top-k chunks, prompt the LLM with grounding instructions.
if valid quantity/unit metadata is returned, attach it to the property.
else mark the property as ungroundable or non-physical.
Step 3. Integrate all grounded properties back into the process schema.
Step 4. Collect expert corrections and apply them to the grounded schema.
Key point: the agent first uses cheap lexical matching, then falls back to embedding-based retrieval + LLM reasoning only when needed.
This makes grounding more traceable than a single prompt that asks the LLM to align every schema term at once.
The final human validation loop is essential because correct quantity kind and practically appropriate unit are not always identical.
Compact redraw for Notion display; the original pseudocode crop was read from the paper.
